<script id="ayoba-live-update">
// Ayoba public presentation; the studio backend is deliberately excluded.
(() => {
  const route = location.pathname.replace(//+$/, '') || '/';
  if (!['/', '/about', '/private-sessions', '/group-journeys', '/contact', '/faq', '/participant-agreement', '/cancellation-refund-policy', '/privacy-policy'].includes(route)) return;
  function fragment(html) {
    const template = document.createElement('template');
    template.innerHTML = html;
    return template.content;
  }
  function style(id, file, text) {
    if (document.getElementById(id) || document.querySelector('link[href*="/assets/' + file + '"]')) return;
    const element = document.createElement('style');
    element.id = id; element.textContent = text; document.head.append(element);
  }
  function apply() {
    style('ayoba-art-direction','art-direction.css',"/* Ayoba: movement as an art practice. Additive styles preserve existing layouts. */
.movement-manifesto{position:relative;background:#f0e9dc;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.movement-manifesto:before{content:"";position:absolute;top:0;left:5%;width:90%;height:1px;background:var(--line)}
.movement-manifesto h2{font-size:clamp(36px,4.65vw,70px);max-width:1160px;line-height:1.17;letter-spacing:-2px;font-weight:500;margin-bottom:66px;text-wrap:pretty}
.movement-manifesto h2 em{display:inline-block;font-size:1.28em;line-height:.8;transform:rotate(-4deg);padding-inline:.06em;color:var(--berry)}
.intention-layout{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1.1fr;gap:80px;align-items:center}
.intention-copy{max-width:480px}.intention-copy p{font-size:15px;line-height:1.85;margin:0 0 20px}.intention-copy .textlink{margin-top:12px}
.movement-study{background:#e5dfcd;color:var(--berry);border:1px solid #55583a40;transform:rotate(2deg);position:relative;padding:20px 23px 17px}
.study-heading{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;color:var(--ink)}.study-heading .eyebrow{margin:0;font-size:9px}.study-number{font:italic 23px Instrument,Georgia,serif}
.gesture-surface{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;aspect-ratio:5/3;touch-action:none;cursor:crosshair;overflow:hidden}
.study-footer{border-top:1px solid #55583a40;color:var(--ink);padding-top:14px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:14px}.study-footer p{font-size:10px;line-height:1.6;margin:0;max-width:160px}.study-footer>div{display:flex;gap:15px}.study-footer button{font:11px DM,Arial,sans-serif;background:none;color:var(--ink);border:0;border-bottom:1px solid currentColor;min-height:38px;padding:4px 0;cursor:pointer}.study-footer button:hover{color:var(--berry)}
.sr-only{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;padding:0;margin:-1px;overflow:hidden;clip-path:inset(50%);white-space:nowrap;border:0}
.page .art-title{font-size:clamp(68px,10.5vw,150px);font-weight:500;letter-spacing:-6px;line-height:1.03;margin-bottom:55px}.art-title em{font-size:1.2em;color:var(--berry)}
.art-title~.content-columns .about-photo{transform:rotate(2deg);margin:10px 10px 40px}.art-title~.photo-essay .photo-essay-grid figure:first-child{transform:rotate(-2deg)}.art-title~.photo-essay .photo-essay-grid figure:last-child{transform:rotate(2deg)}

    return !failed && wantsMotion && inView && !document.hidden && (!film || film.paused);
  }
  async function resume() {
    if (!canResume()) return;
    if (pending) { queuedResume = true; return; }
    if (!video.getAttribute('src')) video.src = video.dataset.src;
    pending = true;
    queuedResume = false;
    let interrupted = false;
    try {
      await video.play();
      if (!canResume()) pause();
    } catch (error) {
      interrupted = error?.name === 'AbortError';
      // Autoplay restrictions leave the poster and manual Play control usable.
    } finally {
      pending = false;
      const retry = interrupted && queuedResume && canResume();
      queuedResume = false;
      update();
      if (retry) resume();
    }
  }
  function pause() { queuedResume = false; video.pause(); update(); }
  toggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
    wantsMotion = video.paused;
    if (wantsMotion) resume(); else pause();
  });
  video.addEventListener('playing', () => {hero.classList.add('is-video-ready'); update();});
  video.addEventListener('pause', update);
  video.addEventListener('error', () => {
    failed = true;
    wantsMotion = false;
    hero.classList.remove('is-video-ready');
    pause();
  });
  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {if (document.hidden) pause(); else resume();});
  reduced.addEventListener('change', () => {if (reduced.matches) {wantsMotion = false; pause();}});
  if ('IntersectionObserver' in window) {
    new IntersectionObserver(entries => {
      inView = entries[0].isIntersecting;
      if (inView) resume(); else pause();
    }, {threshold: 0.05}).observe(hero);
  }
  if (film) {
    film.addEventListener('play', pause);
    film.addEventListener('pause', resume);
    film.addEventListener('ended', resume);
  }
  update();
  resume();
})();

    /* Section links stay ordinary URLs: keyboard navigation, history and deep links work. */
(() => {
  const header = document.querySelector('body > header');
  const nav = document.querySelector('#navlinks');
  if (!header || !nav || header.dataset.sectionsReady) return;
  header.dataset.sectionsReady = 'true';
  header.setAttribute('data-section-header', '');
  const home = (location.pathname.replace(//+$/, '') || '/') === '/';
  document.body.classList.add('ayoba-simple');
  document.body.classList.toggle('ayoba-simple-home', home);
  const menu = document.querySelector('.menu-button');
  nav.addEventListener('click', event => {
    if (!event.target.closest('a')) return;
    menu?.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
    nav.dataset.open = 'false';
  });
  const links = Array.from(nav.querySelectorAll('a[href*="#"]'));
  const targets = links.map(link => document.getElementById(new URL(link.href).hash.slice(1)));
  let scheduled = false;
  function update() {
    scheduled = false;
    const height = Math.ceil(header.getBoundingClientRect().height);
    document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--section-header-height', height + 'px');
    if (!home) return;
    let current = -1;
    targets.forEach((target, index) => {
      if (target && target.getBoundingClientRect().top <= height + 90) current = index;
    });
    links.forEach((link, index) => {
      if (index === current) link.setAttribute('aria-current', 'location');
      else link.removeAttribute('aria-current');
    });
  }
  function schedule() {
    if (!scheduled) { scheduled = true; requestAnimationFrame(update); }
  }
  window.addEventListener('scroll', schedule, {passive: true});
  window.addEventListener('resize', schedule, {passive: true});
  if ('ResizeObserver' in window) new ResizeObserver(schedule).observe(header);
  update();
  if (!home) {
    const section = {'/about':'about', '/private-sessions':'sessions', '/group-journeys':'sessions', '/contact':'book', '/faq':'book'}[location.pathname.replace(//+$/, '')];
    links.find(link => new URL(link.href).hash === '#' + section)?.setAttribute('aria-current','location');
  }
  // Snippet layout can move the requested target after the browser's first hash jump.
  if (home && location.hash && !document.documentElement.dataset.sectionHashRestored) {
    const target = document.getElementById(location.hash.slice(1));
    if (target) {
      document.documentElement.dataset.sectionHashRestored = 'true';
      const requestedHash = location.hash;
      let interrupted = false;
      const cancel = () => { interrupted = true; };
      ['pointerdown','wheel','touchstart','keydown'].forEach(type => window.addEventListener(type, cancel, {once:true, passive:true}));
      function alignHash() {
        requestAnimationFrame(() => {
          if (interrupted || location.hash !== requestedHash) return;
          update(); target.scrollIntoView({behavior:'instant', block:'start'});
        });
      }
      alignHash();
      if (document.readyState !== 'complete') window.addEventListener('load', alignHash, {once:true});
      document.fonts?.ready.then(alignHash);
    }
  }
})();

  }
  if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', apply, {once:true});
  else apply();
})();
